item.title: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing update
item.description:
📝 🚀 🔷 Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains. API pricing update 💰 With the V4 lineup release, we’re updating our API pricing and introducing peak and off-peak rates. Off-peak rates are 50% lower than peak, enabling more flexible workload scheduling.
🔗 Read more: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news260813/

item.title: Why does Opus 5 feel worse to work with?
item.description:
📝 Why does Opus 5 feel worse to work with. Because of this, they don't require the careful babysitting that Opus 5 does. That doesn't mean a good task can only have one correct answer, just that it should score all unambiguously correct answers equally.
🔗 Read more: https://mun-logadan.github.io/why-does-opus-5-feel-worse/
